title: The Unwound Hourglass
summary: Beneath the timeless orchards of Artaeum, Psijic Order loremasters at Cephorah Tower and the Dreaming Cave must seal a leaking chronal vault before an intruder extracts a forbidden Old Ways relic.

hook.rumour: Initiates tending the orchards around Cephorah Tower report that fallen blossoms are rising back onto the boughs as a chronal fissure leaks beneath the Dreaming Cave.
hook.notice: CONCLAVE OF THE OLD WAYS: Adepts and sworn guests at Artaeum are summoned to stabilize the chronal seals between Cephorah Tower and the Villa.

npcs.name: Warden of Artaeum
npcs.greet: Initiates tending the orchards around Cephorah Tower report that fallen blossoms are rising back onto the boughs as a chronal fissure leaks beneath the Dreaming Cave.
talk: The trouble across Artaeum began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Artaeum.
If you mean to help the Psijic Conclave of Artaeum, start by checking the trail between Artaeum and Psijic Relic Vaults.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Artaeum
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Psijic Relic Vaults is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Psijic Relic Vaults toward Artaeum Craftworks before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Artaeum so Ritemaster Iachesis-Cel can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Artaeum Craftworks
npcs.greet: You made good time from Psijic Relic Vaults. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near College of Psijics Ruins.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at College of Psijics Ruins with a picked guard.
Once College of Psijics Ruins is cleared, return to Artaeum to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Artaeum
npcs.greet: Ritemaster Iachesis-Cel awaits word on whether the crisis in Artaeum has been contained.
talk: The elders of Artaeum have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Artaeum owes you a debt for standing between Artaeum and ruin.
